This PKGBUILD follows standard Arch Linux packaging practices for a precompiled binary package. The source is downloaded from the project's own upstream GitLab domain (iriun.gitlab.io) over HTTP, with pinned SHA256 checksums verifying the integrity of the downloaded file. The `package()` function simply extracts the Debian package archive and relocates files to standard FHS locations, moves configuration files, fixes the desktop file path, installs the license, and sets appropriate permissions. There is no obfuscation, no unexpected network requests beyond the declared source, no execution of untrusted fetched code, no attempts to exfiltrate data, and no system modifications unrelated to the package's stated purpose. The use of HTTP instead of HTTPS is a best-practice concern but does not indicate malice, especially given the pinned checksum. The file contains no genuinely malicious behavior.
</details>
